age.genesis.armor.copper.description: Obtain 25 levels of XP; unlocks copper armor.
age.genesis.armor.diamond.description: Complete an Ominous Trial Spawner while wearing iron armor; unlocks diamond armor.
age.genesis.armor.iron.description: Complete a Trial Spawner while wearing copper armor; unlocks iron and gold armor.
age.genesis.proficiency.combat.descripti: Kill 25 hostile mobs; improves sword and axe damage.
age.genesis.proficiency.smelting.descrip: Obtain 20 levels of XP; unlocks furnace blocks.
age.genesis.proficiency.arcane.descripti: Enchant an item; unlocks The Nether dimension.
age.genesis.story.end.description: Complete all Story ages; unlocks the Eye of Ender and The End dimension.
age.genesis.story.ocean.description: Complete an Ocean Monument; unlocks Tridents.
age.genesis.story.war.description: Complete a raid; unlocks Shield Casts.
age.genesis.story.sculk.description: Discover loot in an Ancient City; unlocks Anvil Casts.
age.genesis.story.wither.description: Kill the Wither; unlocks Enchanted Golden Apples.
age.genesis.tools.copper.description: Break a stone tool; unlocks copper tools.
age.genesis.tools.diamond.description: Break an iron tool; unlocks diamond tools.
age.genesis.tools.iron.description: Break a copper tool; unlocks iron tools.
age.genesis.tools.stone.description: Break a wooden tool; unlocks stone tools.
block.minecraft.bed.genesis.tiredness: You may not rest now; You're not tired
container.genesis.assembly_table.title: Assemble Items
entity.genesis.boar.description: A hostile wild pig that charges players and destroys crops. It drops leather and sometimes pork.
Controls if killing a elder guardian will apply a glowing effect to the remaining elder guardians.
gamerule.genesis.ocean_monument_radius.d: Controls the radius used to search for nearby Elder Guardians.
gamerule.genesis.respawn_resets_tirednes: Controls whether dying resets a player's tiredness to 0.
Controls the required radius to be healed by a campfire after healing.
gamerule.genesis.tiredness_rate.descript: Controls how many days it takes for a player to become tired; scales with the sleep percentage game rule.

lore.genesis.anvil_cast: A single-use pattern that can be used in an Assembly Table to craft anvils.
lore.genesis.assembly_table: A specialized crafting table that uses single-use casts to assemble tools and other shaped items.
lore.genesis.axe_cast: A single-use pattern that can be used in an Assembly Table to craft axes.
lore.genesis.blank_clay_cast: A blank mold made from Clay. Shape it with Flint, then fire it to create a cast for the Assembly Table.
lore.genesis.boar_spawn_egg: Spawns a hostile Boar that charges players and destroys crops.
lore.genesis.clay_anvil_cast: An unfired mold shaped for anvils. Fire it on a Campfire or in a Blast Furnace to create an Anvil Cast.
lore.genesis.clay_axe_cast: An unfired mold shaped for axes. Fire it on a Campfire or in a Blast Furnace to create an Axe Cast.
lore.genesis.clay_cauldron: An unfired cauldron made from Clay. Fire it on a Campfire or in a Blast Furnace to create a Terracotta Cauldron.
lore.genesis.clay_hoe_cast: An unfired mold shaped for hoes. Fire it on a Campfire or in a Blast Furnace to create a Hoe Cast.
lore.genesis.clay_kiln: An unfired kiln made from Clay. Fire it on a Campfire or in a Blast Furnace to create a Kiln.
lore.genesis.clay_pickaxe_cast: An unfired mold shaped for pickaxes. Fire it on a Campfire or in a Blast Furnace to create a Pickaxe Cast.
lore.genesis.clay_shield_cast: An unfired mold shaped for shields. Fire it on a Campfire or in a Blast Furnace to create a Shield Cast.
lore.genesis.clay_shovel_cast: An unfired mold shaped for shovels. Fire it on a Campfire or in a Blast Furnace to create a Shovel Cast.
lore.genesis.clay_spear_cast: An unfired mold shaped for spears. Fire it on a Campfire or in a Blast Furnace to create a Spear Cast.
lore.genesis.clay_sword_cast: An unfired mold shaped for swords. Fire it on a Campfire or in a Blast Furnace to create a Sword Cast.
lore.genesis.clay_totem_cast: An unfired mold shaped for a Totem of Undying. Fire it on a Campfire or in a Blast Furnace to create a Totem Cast.
lore.genesis.dirt_terracotta_cauldron: A Terracotta Cauldron filled with Dirt. Sift it by hand, or use a Brush for better drops.
lore.genesis.enchanted_honey_bottle: Grants Regeneration II for 15 seconds and cures Poison and Wither.
lore.genesis.flints: Use on four dropped sticks to create a Campfire.
lore.genesis.gravel_terracotta_cauldron: A Terracotta Cauldron filled with Gravel. Sift it by hand, or use a Brush for better drops.
lore.genesis.hoe_cast: A single-use pattern that can be used in an Assembly Table to craft hoes.
lore.genesis.kiln: Smelts items without consuming fuel by using fire or a lit Campfire underneath.
lore.genesis.pickaxe_cast: A single-use pattern that can be used in an Assembly Table to craft pickaxes.
lore.genesis.raw_coal: Unrefined Coal dropped from ore. Smelt it into Coal or craft nine into a storage block.
lore.genesis.raw_coal_block: A compact storage block crafted from nine Raw Coal. It can be unpacked for later processing.
lore.genesis.raw_diamond: An uncut Diamond dropped from ore. Smelt it into a Diamond or craft nine into a storage block.
lore.genesis.raw_diamond_block: A compact storage block crafted from nine Raw Diamonds. It can be unpacked for later processing.
lore.genesis.raw_emerald: An uncut Emerald dropped from ore. Smelt it into an Emerald or craft nine into a storage block.
lore.genesis.raw_emerald_block: A compact storage block crafted from nine Raw Emeralds. It can be unpacked for later processing.
lore.genesis.raw_lapis_lazuli: Unrefined Lapis Lazuli dropped from ore. Smelt it into Lapis Lazuli or craft nine into a storage block.
lore.genesis.raw_lapis_lazuli_block: A compact storage block crafted from nine Raw Lapis Lazuli. It can be unpacked for later processing.
lore.genesis.raw_netherite: Unrefined Netherite recovered from Ancient Debris. Smelt it into Netherite Scrap or craft nine into a storage block.
lore.genesis.raw_netherite_block: A blast-resistant storage block crafted from nine Raw Netherite. It can be unpacked for later processing.
lore.genesis.raw_redstone: Unrefined Redstone dropped from ore. Smelt it into Redstone Dust or craft nine into a storage block.
lore.genesis.raw_redstone_block: A compact storage block crafted from nine Raw Redstone. It can be unpacked for later processing.
lore.genesis.shield_cast: A single-use pattern that can be used in an Assembly Table to craft shields.
lore.genesis.shovel_cast: A single-use pattern that can be used in an Assembly Table to craft shovels.
lore.genesis.soul_sand_terracotta_cauldr: A Terracotta Cauldron filled with Soul Sand. Sift it by hand, or use a Brush for better drops.
lore.genesis.soul_soil_terracotta_cauldr: A Terracotta Cauldron filled with Soul Soil. Sift it by hand, or use a Brush for better drops.
lore.genesis.spear_cast: A single-use pattern that can be used in an Assembly Table to craft spears.
lore.genesis.sword_cast: A single-use pattern that can be used in an Assembly Table to craft swords.
lore.genesis.terracotta_cauldron: Fill it with Dirt, Gravel, Soul Sand, or Soul Soil, then sift the contents. Using a Brush improves the drops.
lore.genesis.totem_cast: A single-use pattern that can be used in an Assembly Table to craft a Totem of Undying.
